*Speed* has dimension L T^-1^ whereas *distance* has dimension L. What is the relationship between speed and distance?

```{mcq}
#| label: asp-1-csl
1. Distance is proportional to speed. [hint: No, they have different dimensions.]
2. Distance is the derivative of speed with respect to time.
3. Distance is the accumulation of speed with respect to time. [correct]
4. Distance and speed have unrelated dimensions.
```
:::
